observations: Bright interdendritic phase forms a continuous network in (a), isolated particles in (b), thin broken strings in (c)
Extra reflections (stars, ~21-37, 50, 67 deg) appear only in the Al-Cu-Mn-La pattern; Sm pattern matches the RE-free one
Arrow B in (c) marks a second, finer bright boundary phase beside the arrow-A particles
La alloy shows weak peak A (~605 C) and shoulder B (~638 C), assigned to Al2Cu and Al6Cu6La dissolution
Precipitate plate length ~20-40 nm in (a), ~10 nm in (b), ~5-10 nm in (c)
Precipitate number density visibly rises from (a) to (b) to (c)
